source.author: verg
source.text: Quos ego sed motos praestat componere fluctus.
source.text_original: Quos ego — sed motos praestat componere fluctus.
source.text_english: Those waves, however, though stirred, it is better for me to calm.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: But it is better to settle the stirred-up waves.
